overview: This one-page file consists of a register or “List of Papers” entry concerning coal in Japanese-controlled southern Sakhalin. It records that no semi-anthracite coal was mined there and directs the reader to telegram no. 121 from Tokyo, filed elsewhere under decimal reference 142.12/4159. The sheet therefore functions primarily as an index and cross-reference rather than preserving the underlying telegram itself.

subfiles.title: List of Papers note on semi-anthracite coal in Japanese Sakhalin
subfiles.about: An index note states that no semi-anthracite coal was mined in Japanese Sakhalin and points to a Tokyo telegram filed under another decimal number.
subfiles.summary: The sheet lists the subject as coal in Japanese Sakhalin and contains a single entry dated February 10. It reports the absence of semi-anthracite mining in the territory. Researchers are referred to file 142.12/4159 for telegram no. 121 from Tokyo, parenthetically associated with “Sarrala.”

interest: The document is useful as evidence of State Department filing practice and of official interest in the composition and availability of Sakhalin coal. Its substantive claim—that semi-anthracite was not mined in Japanese-controlled Sakhalin—is concise but potentially valuable for histories of imperial Japanese resource development. The cross-reference also identifies an underlying Tokyo telegram that may contain the fuller report, although it is not present in this file.
